# easyDevicePic

> A free browser tool that maps a screenshot onto a 3D phone or laptop model,
> lets you rotate the device to any angle, and exports the render as a PNG with
> a transparent background. No account, no sign-up, no upload: the 3D rendering
> and the PNG export both run locally in the browser, so images never leave the
> visitor's machine.

## What it is for

Making device mockups — a screenshot of an app or a website shown on a phone or
a laptop — for landing pages, slide decks, app-store listings, README files and
social previews, without hunting down a licensed photograph of a device.

## How it works

- Pick a device: phone or laptop.
- Drop in an image, or choose one from the file picker. On mobile, take a photo.
- Choose how the picture fills the screen: stretch, cover or contain.
- Rotate the device by dragging, or set exact X / Y / Z angles with sliders.
- Download the result as a PNG with a fully transparent background.

Built with Three.js and WebGL. No server component and no analytics.

## Languages

English and French, as separate documents — every page below is fully readable
without executing JavaScript. On the English home page the interface language
also follows the browser, and can be forced with a `?lang=en` or `?lang=fr`
query parameter.

- [Confidentialité](https://easydevicepic.andretousch.com/confidentialite.html): the Privacy page, in French.
